leftEvidence.title: The Levites are taken in place of Israel’s firstborn because of the day Egypt’s firstborn were struck

points.label: Exchange
points.left: Levites stand in place of every firstborn who opens the womb.
points.right: Levites are separated from Israel and given in place of all firstborn.

points.label: Earlier day
points.left: The striking of Egypt’s firstborn grounds the claim.
points.right: The same day grounds the later explanation.

points.label: Purpose
points.left: The closing declaration is “They shall be mine.”
points.right: Service, atonement, and protection at the sanctuary are added.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: The substitution is repeated and joined to sanctuary service and atonement for Israel

payload.tension: The same firstborn-night rationale is repeated, while the second passage expands what the Levites’ substitution does.
payload.title: The Levites in place of the firstborn
